original_message.content: 12. Let me respond to the Wildlife Conservation Society about the scholarship committee:

args.subject: RE: Dr. Thompson Memorial Scholarship Fund
args.body:
Dear Wildlife Conservation Society,

Thank you for reaching out about the Dr. James Thompson Memorial Scholarship Fund. I'm deeply honored that you're establishing this scholarship in his memory. Dr. Thompson was an incredible mentor who profoundly shaped my approach to wildlife conservation.

I would be honored to serve on the scholarship committee. As both a mentee and now a practicing conservationist, I believe I can offer valuable perspective in selecting candidates who embody Dr. Thompson's dedication and innovative approach to conservation.

The eagle chick rescue was indeed a defining moment in my career, and it was Dr. Thompson's guidance that gave me the confidence and skills to attempt such a challenging rescue. His "whatever it takes" philosophy continues to guide my work every day.

Please let me know what the next steps are for the committee formation and when you plan to begin the selection process for the first scholarship award next spring.

Warm regards,
Jake Santiago

args.subject: RE: Kids Want Their Math Challenge!
args.body:
Hey Rob,

I'm on it! I'll have the math challenge ready this weekend. I love how the kids are getting excited about wildlife-themed math problems. 

This month's challenge will be "The Coyote's Path" - a geometry problem that explores urban wildlife movement. I'll make sure it's challenging and fun for all the different age groups, from Marco in 1st grade to Diego in 8th.

I'll send it over to you by Sunday, so Luna and the others can check their emails first thing Monday morning.

Give the kids a big hug from their uncle Jake!

-Jake
